title: Quantum mechanics II
purpose: Use abstract states, spin and approximation techniques to solve quantum systems beyond exact models.
primary_reading: MIT 8.05 Quantum Physics II (use the supplements described in Section 12 for topics beyond the primary source.)

blocks.deliverable: Express the same state and operator in two bases.
Week 7 midterm; assess an energy bound and its assumptions.
Calculate a transition probability in a controlled regime.
Quantify approximation error and complete a QM II final.

project: Compare perturbation theory and matrix diagonalization for a weakly coupled quantum model.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
